name: @tmnl/mathkernel
author: GBG
description: WASM compute substrate — C++20/Eigen linear algebra, regression, decomposition, time series, DSP, and statistics via Emscripten/Embind. Effect-native service layer for @tmnl/datagrid Stack VM and codemode agent API.

scripts.build:wasm: mkdir -p build && cd build && emcmake cmake .. -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build . --parallel && cd .. && bun run scripts/patch-wasm-glue.mjs
scripts.build: bun run build:wasm && bun run build:ts
